messages.content: Hey, just got back from walking Biscuit in Tiergarten. Berlin in spring is unreal.
Sounds lovely! How long have you had Biscuit?
About four years. He's a beagle. By the way I'm vegetarian, can you suggest a brunch place near Mitte?
Sure — House of Small Wonder or Silo Coffee both have great vegetarian options.
Tough day at Stripe. Roadmap planning ran three hours over.
Ouch. Are you the PM driving the agenda?
Yeah, PM on the payments team.
Big news — I just signed at Notion. Starting Monday as a senior PM on the AI team. Leaving Stripe was hard but the offer was too good.
Congratulations! That's a huge move. What pulled you in?
The AI roadmap, mostly. Also closer to home — I can bike to the office now.
Mochi knocked over my coffee for the third time this week. Cats.
Two. Tortoiseshell. We rescued her from a shelter in Lisbon last summer.
Anyway, on-call week from hell at Cloudflare. Three pager incidents in two days.
SRE — edge network. Also FYI I'm allergic to peanuts, so any snack suggestions for late-night ops, skip the Snickers.
Actually, sorry — I said tortoiseshell earlier. Mochi is a calico. My partner just corrected me.
